title: Design System
subtitle: One library, thirteen brands
summary: The 50+ component library behind the MyLoyal app, themed across 13+ brands and serving 750k+ users, so features ship to every brand at once instead of brand by brand.

title: Club Invitation Links
subtitle: Self-serve club onboarding via a magic link
summary: Club managers were adding members one at a time by hand. I designed a magic-link invitation flow, so onboarding became a single shareable link, with domain whitelisting and expiration controls managers own themselves.

title: Activity Feed
subtitle: A persistent engagement surface for the app
summary: Push notifications die the moment they're swiped away. I'm designing a persistent 13-card activity feed, with carousel mechanics and a state machine, so quests, offers, and notifications have a place users can return to.

title: Campaigns Management
subtitle: A campaign builder brands can run themselves
summary: Loyalty campaigns depend on timing, audience, qualifying purchases, rewards and limits all lining up. I designed a seven-step campaign builder and its full lifecycle, from Draft to Archived, and prototyped it end to end so edge cases surfaced before engineering.

title: Sticky Offers & Card Tags
subtitle: Making urgency readable at a glance
summary: An offer can be time-limited, new, limited in stock, from a partner, or usable several times, often all at once. I designed a tag system for offer cards so members can see what matters, and what's about to expire, before opening anything.

title: Full Receipts
subtitle: From a purchase list to a real receipt
summary: Purchase history showed totals and points, but not the receipt behind them. I designed a full receipt in the member app: line items from the POS, loyalty applied, taxes, what the purchase earned and payment details, with the messy edge cases designed in.

title: User Overview
subtitle: One page to support any member
summary: Support staff need to answer “what happened to this member?” quickly and fix it safely. I redesigned the member page in the admin: balances, manual adjustments with a reason, offer redemption and undo, and a filterable activity timeline, with guardrails for each admin role.
